title: Amar Shapath
desc: A young boy's parents are killed by a dangerous criminal who also kidnaps his sister. Several years later, he plans to find his sister and avenge his parents' death by murdering the culprit.

desc: Bijay, a rich tea estate owner's son, angers his father when he marries a poor girl. Ranjan, his cousin, tries to make the most of the situation by usurping his property.

title: Ashirbad
desc: Brijlal, a cunning entrepreneur, plots to kill his partner and his son. However, the son survives and years later, ends up falling in love with Brijlal's daughter.

desc: A powerful landowner conducts his business and lives his life with cruelty. However, various circumstances influence him to change his nature and tactics over time.

desc: Upama, who is in her seventies, shares a strained bond with her son Soumya. Meanwhile, her close connection with young Bittu highlights family rifts.

desc: Apu chases his dream of being a globetrotter with his son. He balances their long journeys by ensuring his son's safety and meeting family.

title: Biye.Com
